system.description:
Acquired with CR21 or higher. The target gains a +[POW mod] bonus to damage rolls. 

(Effect): While this [Harmony] is in effect, increase your [Hate] by +3 during the Cleanup Process of every round.

(SR2): Gain +2 [Hate] instead of +3 during the Cleanup Process.

A support song that plays an overture that foreshadows the advance of the bamboo shoots, and raises the morale of the comrades fiercely. Each person who listens to this song becomes a mighty warrior.
